_readme: See art/stage1/README.md section "달리기·점프". Frames 176x136, facing right, pivot (68,130) = feet on the ground. Frame indices are 0-based. Distances in px at scale 1.0 (game draws at actorScale 0.55 -> multiply).

run.note: Move the body travelPerFrame[i] px while frame i is shown (= speed * ms[i]) and the planted foot does not slide. To run faster/slower keep the ms RATIOS and scale all ms by the same factor (speed = strideLoop / loopMs).
run.enter: from idle/walk start at frame 0 (contact); stop -> idle (or walk_01)

jump.drive: code-driven arc: show 0 for ms.takeoff on the ground, then lift off; 1 while rising (vz up, z < 70% of max), 2 around the top (|vz| small or z >= 70% of max), 3 while falling, 4 for ms.land after touching down, then idle. Frames 1-3 are drawn with their centre of mass at the idle centre of mass, but never with the feet below y=130 (so at z=0 the feet touch the ground). Frames 0 and 4 stand on y=130.

multiHit.note: loop frames 1-2 while sliding / charging forward; the enemy in contact is PUSHED along with the hero (move it with the hero) and takes a small hit each tick (~90 ms)

finishHit.effect: blow back far (big knockback, no knockdown required)

bodyTravel.note: the game moves the body forward during the push loop (frames are drawn in place); slow down to 0 on finish

jump_attack.startFrom: any airborne moment (apex or fall); keep the jump arc running; if the hero lands during 0-2, cut to jump frame 4 (land)
